Au - Gratin Potatoes
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 12:13am

Ingredients




4 lg. potatoes
1 teaspoon salt
1 can cream of chicken soup
 cup milk
1 cup grated cheese
1 med. onion

Preparation

1 Cook sliced potatoes for 5 minutes with 1 teaspoon salt; drain. Heat soup, milk and minced onions. Add 3/4 of the cheese. Place a layer of potatoes, then a layer of mixture. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.
